description: Re-send a stored event to its destinations. Replays sit outside the monthly event quota but within a daily replay limit per plan and the monthly compute allowance (anyhook_usage), and replaying an event that was held for quota bills it as a new event. The destination does run its handler again: a receiver that is not idempotent will process the event twice while debugging.

id.description: Event ID to replay. Replay does not consume event quota; it is charged to the compute allowance.

name: anyhook_replay
title: Replay an event
